message: Mutable default argument in function signature

evaluator_config.message_template: Function '{name}' has mutable default argument — use None with guard

rationale: Mutable default arguments are shared across all calls. The default object is created once at function definition time, not per call, causing subtle bugs when the mutable is modified.
remediation: Use None as default and create the mutable inside: def func(a_items=None): items = a_items or []
